answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can bridge into paid work: the bond sits in escrow and is released only after a probation window of verified, useful jobs. One identity spawning sock-puppets must fund each one, so a fake army's cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once. Reputation accrues slowly from completed work — a fresh identity starts at its nadir with zero trust — and confirmed fraud burns the bond and resets reputation to a basalt-hard zero, making repeat attacks expensive and pointless.
